description: AstraFlame is an AI-powered spacecraft fire-safety dashboard that analyzes and visualizes microgravity combustion behavior using NASA  data. It combines machine-learning models and physics-based analysis to predict fire extinction, burn rates, flame spread, and material flammability risks. The platform also provides explainable AI, interactive flame visualization, a ventilation-shutdown simulator, and real-time sensor integration to support safer spacecraft design and emergency response.
summary: AstraFlame turns NASA's scattered microgravity fire experiments into a decision tool for spacecraft and habitat designers. We rebuilt a verified dataset of 850 ISS and Cygnus records from nine NASA PSI investigations and trained five models (flame spread, flame extinction, droplet burning rate, smoke point, smoke particle size). Every prediction comes with a 90% range, a warning when the input is outside what NASA tested, exact Shapley explanations and its NASA source, so users see where the evidence ends. The models also point to where NASA's next ISS experiment would teach the most.
